# Incident INC-6902: Order ingestion rewrite

**Severity:** SEV1 · **Started:** 2026-10-20T15:33:22.640Z · **Resolved:** 2026-10-11T04:45:00Z · **Duration:** 45 minutes

## Summary

Between 2026-10-20T15:33:22.640Z and 2026-10-11T04:45:00Z, requests to `catalog-api` on port `3000` failed with HTTP 502.
The on-call engineer was paged after 2 minutes.

## Impact

- 4 users affected (~11% of traffic)
- 1200 requests per second were rejected
- Estimated revenue impact: $1200

## Timeline

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 2026-10-20T15:33:22.640Z | Alert fired: `HighErrorRate` on `catalog-api` |
| 2026-10-20T15:33:22.640Z | On-call acknowledged the page |
| 2026-10-20T15:33:22.640Z | Root cause identified: an unbounded retry loop amplified load during a partial outage |
| 2026-10-20T15:33:22.640Z | Mitigation applied: disabled the feature flag and scaled the service up |
| 2026-10-20T15:33:22.640Z | Recovery confirmed, alerts silenced |

## Root cause

an unbounded retry loop amplified load during a partial outage

The deploy at 2026-10-20T15:33:22.640Z increased the connection pool from 20 to 120, which
exceeded the database limit of 50.

## Action items

- [ ] Add a pool-size alert below 70% saturation (owner: platform)
- [ ] Add a load test that reproduces the saturation point (owner: sre)
